mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_kb_document (category_id, title, file_name, file_path, file_type, file_size, status, vector_count, upload_user_id) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{title}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileType}, #{fileSize}, #{status}, #{vectorCount}, #{uploadUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(d.id) AS value FROM t_kb_category c LEFT JOIN t_kb_document d ON d.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.sort_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_kb_document WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
